import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize species labels (strip stray whitespace)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Normalize island labels (case variant)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Parse body_mass_g: numbers written as text with commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Drop rows with unparseable/missing body mass or species
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    g = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in g.items()}
